headline: Frontend Engineer
summary: Frontend engineer with 8+ years of hand-written HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, from pixel-perfect design-to-code to legacy web layouts. Accessibility-focused (ARIA, landmarks, heading hierarchy). Experienced code reviewer of human and AI-generated code.

bullets: Led code review across a Vue.js and Tailwind CSS front-end, enforcing layout fidelity, semantic markup, and maintainable CSS.
Translated Figma prototypes into pixel-perfect, responsive UI for a veterinary SaaS platform.
Debugged layout and rendering with browser DevTools; managed Docker, Git, and AWS from the command line.
Reduced AWS costs by over $6,000/month and mentored developers on front-end standards.
Shipped 11+ frontend web applications with hand-written HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and CLI data seeders.
Rebuilt legacy web layouts, including an early-2000s department directory, as semantic, responsive pages.
Built layouts with Flexbox, CSS Grid, and media queries, including a concurrent-session event schedule.
Met WCAG standards with ARIA, semantic landmarks, heading hierarchy, and tested color contrast.
